name: Sam bo luong
summary: One of the light orders at the night court inside the Mỹ Tho tourist-boat pier, served beside chè and sinh tố after the noodle and rice bowls.
origin: The pier night court on đường 30 Tháng 4.
howToEat: Order a glass after the riverside walk, when the court is busiest.
where: Inside the tourist-boat pier on đường 30 Tháng 4: 18:30–02:00 in a 5 Jan 2019 provincial article, or from 18:00 and busiest 19:00–22:00 on Viet Fun Travel.
seoTitle: Sam bo luong at the My Tho pier
seoDescription: Sâm bổ lượng at the Mỹ Tho pier night court on đường 30 Tháng 4, beside chè and sinh tố.
